title: Obstacles and Singularities of Riemannian Distance Functions
summary: We study the distance function from a point target in the complement of a compact obstacle endowed with a smooth Riemannian metric. We prove that the obstacle necessarily generates singularities of the distance function: every sufficiently high level set contains a singular point. We also show that every singular point outside the obstacle belongs to a nontrivial Lipschitz arc of singularities, thereby extending to the constrained setting classical propagation results for Hamilton--Jacobi equations.
